address: 75/70 Soi Chom Thong 16, Chom Thong Road, Bang Kho, Chom Thong, Bangkok, 10150, Thailand
bio: This hidden gem, tucked away in a Bangkok alley since 1999, excels in fish ball noodle soup. They offer fresh, umami-rich fish balls, al dente noodles, and a savoury, aromatic broth. Optional toppings like cheese and poached egg, along with large servings and ample condiments, provide great taste and value....
